verdict.rationale: The evidence includes items from Google Workspace's own public pricing page (workspace.google.com/pricing), which lists features included in plans such as appointment booking pages and the Migrate tool. That shows a published pricing page with tier inclusions, but no per-seat prices or tier-by-tier breakdown appear in the pack. Missing for 10: per-seat price amounts, explicit tier names with what each includes, any statement that buying needs no sales contact, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-seat pricing tells me exactly what each tier costs and includes before I talk to sales

citations.quote: Google Workspace Migrate tool for data migration
